portInfo.description: Nantes’s castle, art/gardens and Île de Nantes mechanical creations can form a strong city visit. The Gallery and Carrousel remain separate attractions from the Elephant journey; the old brochure’s proposed Heron Tree is not treated as an existing ride. Port-authority coverage of the whole estuary does not make every regional berth a Nantes-city terminal.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Château des ducs de Bretagne / history museum — Castle complex, medieval centre of Nantes. Courtyard and museum are different access/ticket propositions; check which is open. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
Galerie des Machines — Les Machines de l’île, Parc des Chantiers, Boulevard Léon Bureau, Nantes. An indoor mechanical-creature venue, not an Elephant ride. Allow 75 minutes; official source.
Carrousel des Mondes Marins — Parc des Chantiers, Île de Nantes. Separate ticket/activity; operating mode varies by calendar. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
Jardin des plantes — Jardin des plantes, Nantes; green-line garden stop. A garden option rather than another queue-heavy attraction. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
Passage Pommeraye — Passage Pommeraye shopping arcade, Nantes city centre. Historic covered arcade; do not assume all shops share public-passage hours. Allow 35 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: A ticket for the Gallery or Carrousel does not buy an Elephant ride; during the explicitly dated maintenance there are no Elephant journeys. Check afternoon opening rather than assuming all Machines activities start in the morning. Gallery/Carrousel tickets give immediate entry after purchase, not a guaranteed advance timed slot.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: From Cheviré reserve 45 minutes each way for authorized port exit, road transfer and city access; these are padded estimates. For an outer-estuary assignment, a 105-minute one-way road allowance to Nantes is a planning hypothesis to validate, not a sourced drive time. A 4–5-hour outer-port window does not support the city programme; choose a locally researched alternative instead. The 2021 brochure’s draft/air-draft tables are historical, not today’s clearance.
